name: Unwelcome Guests
summary: Someone thanks you for helping them survive an encounter with unwelcome guests. Their gratitude is clear, though the trouble that brought you together is not described.

faq.answer: The speaker says you helped them survive, but gives no details about the encounter.
The completion text does not name the speaker.

faq.q: Why are they in my debt?
faq.answer: They say you helped them survive, but do not explain what happened.
